pages.title: About us
pages.intro: The people behind Crumb & Crust Bakery.
pages.text:
Crumb & Crust started in a home kitchen with one sourdough starter and a borrowed oven.

Today we bake every loaf and pastry on Main Street, starting at 4 in the morning, with flour from a mill two hours away.

## What we care about

- Long, slow fermentation
- Local flour and butter
- Nothing left over: day-old bread goes to the food bank

sb1.subject: Quick idea for Crumb & Crust Bakery's website
sb1.text:
Hi there,

I came across Crumb & Crust Bakery on Google Maps and noticed there's no website listed. A lot of people check for a site before they call, especially on their phone.

I put together a free demo of what a new site for Crumb & Crust Bakery could look like, using your details from Google:

https://your-site.example/demos/crumb-crust-bakery-fokuy/

There's no cost to look and nothing to sign up for.

If it's useful, just reply and we can talk through what you'd want on it. If it's not for you, that's fine too.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Your Studio

--
This is a one-time business offer from Your Studio, 100 Example Ave, Springfield, IL 62701.
If you'd rather not hear from me again, reply "no thanks" and I won't contact you again.
